title: Static dive / sonar beacon
generator: Procedural geometry written in Python (Assets/ModelFactory/Tools/dlmesh.py v2 + source/generate_dl003.py) run in a Claude session. Not AI text-to-3D, not hand-sculpted in Blender. v2 adds chamfered edges, baked vertex-colour ambient occlusion, smoothed normals, box-projected UVs and procedural grayscale detail textures.
format: glTF 2.0 binary (.glb; textures embedded) plus Wavefront OBJ/MTL (with vn/vt and AO vertex colours)
textures: procedural grayscale detail maps (256 px, tileable, multiplied with the material colour): panel, metal, rock, organic - see textures/; emissive, glass and FX materials are untextured
units: metres in file (1 unit = 1 m in the design sheet); Roblox stud mapping to be set at import
axes: Y up, nose/front toward -Z, +X right (not verified against Roblox import)
pivot: Bottom centre of the base (0,0,0); flat base on y=0.
license: Original procedural work created for the Deep Lantern project; no third-party assets used.
preview: preview.png is a software (numpy) render of the exported geometry; flat shading, not an engine render.
roblox_import: NOT TESTED. Suggested: import .glb/.obj via Studio 3D Importer, one MeshPart per material, set Anchored/CanCollide/CollisionFidelity in Studio; collision should use a simplified hull.
not_verified: UV quality (simple box projection; seams and stretching possible on curved parts)
fit against the existing live submarine/controller contracts
